recap.text: Burgundy, a Krasue burned to charcoal from the waist down, tells crawlers where Remex is kept. Remex, a level one bird with no feathers, explains that a Soul Leech Capacitor turned him into a battery for a working called The Final War. Remex convulses, stripping enchantments and detonating Ranger Conrad E's arrows. Dynamite kills Remex, but the soul release from fallen swordsmen saves NPCs and crawlers.

beats.headline: A survivor gives up his name
beats.text: A woman called Burgundy, one of the Krasue, lies burned to charcoal from the waist down in a building that is coming apart, and she has given two crawlers my name and told them where I am kept. Her husband, she called me: not alive, not dead, something monstrous. Accurate, as far as it goes, and it does not go far. Nobody has had cause to say my name aloud in a very long time. I know what that means. I have known what it would mean since the day I was pulled back.
beats.gist: Burgundy, a Krasue burned to charcoal from the waist down, gives Remex's name to two crawlers.

beats.headline: They take him for a lich
beats.text: They come across the floor towards me with the cat out in front and a fuse somewhere behind, and they have decided that I am a lich, that I am the borough boss, and that finishing me finishes their quest. I am no lich. I am no boss. I am a level one bird with no feathers left and a nick in the plane between the living and the dead, and if they lay a hand on me their souls come out through the scratch and go into the tank, and I have no way on this earth to give them back.
beats.gist: Remex is a level one featherless bird and former magistrate who traps souls in a tank.

beats.headline: Soul Leech Capacitor
beats.text: You asked before you detonated anything, which is more than most would do, so here is the story. A Soul Leech Capacitor is what a necromancer builds when what they want is a battery with a face. The spell reaches for the soul the target loved best and drags that soul back into the world, tied to them for good. Featherfall cast it, wanting power over the swordsmen, with my wife in the room to help, and the feedback killed him, which is exactly what she had planned. Since then the power of this town's soul crystal has run through me, and she has been spending it, and what she is spending it on is a working called The Final War. I agreed to none of it. I would like that written down somewhere.
beats.gist: Remex explains that a Soul Leech Capacitor is a battery with a face.

beats.headline: Four shocks, and a town coming apart
beats.text: Remex is finished. He began to convulse and the settlement went with him: a foreshock that stripped the enchantments off every piece of gear in the district, a second that set weapons off where they hung, a third that took the Enchanted Crown of the Sepsis Whore apart, and a fourth that reached into every crawler's hotlist and set off the first two things on it. Ranger Conrad E's arrows went off in his quiver and took him with them. For the record: he asked them not to come closer, he told them the whole story, and he was the most honest thing in that town.
beats.gist: Remex convulses and destroys the settlement with four shocks.

beats.headline: Remex the Grand
beats.text: The newscast has a name for him now: Remex the Grand, whose tragic, controversial tale finally comes to an end. The footage shows the pus detonating at the warehouse, swordsmen tumbling with their health deep in the red, and Remex curled in his corner, a silhouette of pulsing yellow. The light leaves him two seconds before the blast. He cries out as the dynamite takes him. The soul release from the fallen swordsmen tempers the wild magic, and thousands of NPCs and several dozen crawlers are potentially saved.
beats.gist: Remex the Grand dies in a dynamite blast at a warehouse.

relations.note: The convulsion that ends him is where the scenario begins.
